model.live: 当前计算结果: 芯片结温 313.3 °C; 结到冷却液热阻 0.497 K/W. 超过 SiC 器件常见最高结温 175 °C
model.disclosures:
FEM 训练的代理模型

三维稳态导热 FEM 样本训练；理想界面、常数热导率、芯片顶面均匀热流、Cooler 底面对流，其余表面绝热。浏览器执行代理求值。

峰值与芯片顶面面积平均温度分别预测。分解条由中心线温降 / 总功率得到，不是三维各层独立串联热阻。

验证状态

100 例留出复核：峰值热阻平均 / 最大误差 0.55% / 2.68%，平均结温热阻 0.46% / 2.42%。该留出集在开发中已查看；无独立新测试集或实物试验。

剖面色场来自 FEM 中心剖面的 POD 重构；三维外表面按切比雪夫距离延拓此剖面，并非完整三维温度场。厚度为非均匀视觉放大。

175 °C 是部分 SiC 器件的常见最高结温参考，实际允许值应以具体器件数据手册为准。

model.live: Current calculation: Junction temperature 313.3 °C; Junction-to-fluid resistance 0.497 K/W. Above the common SiC junction-temperature limit of 175 °C
model.disclosures:
FEM-trained surrogate

Trained on 3D steady-conduction FEM samples: ideal contacts, constant conductivity, uniform chip-top heat flux, cooler-bottom convection and other surfaces adiabatic. The browser evaluates the surrogate.

Peak and chip-top area-average temperatures are predicted separately. The breakdown uses centreline temperature drops divided by total power, not independent series resistances of 3D layers.

Validation status

100 held-out cases: peak resistance mean / max error 0.55% / 2.68%; average resistance 0.46% / 2.42%. This holdout was inspected during development; no fresh independent test set or experimental validation.

The cutaway uses a POD reconstruction of the FEM central plane. Outer 3D surfaces extend that plane using Chebyshev distance; this is not a complete 3D temperature field. Thicknesses are visually exaggerated by different factors.

175 °C is a common reference limit for some SiC devices. Use the specific device datasheet to determine its permitted junction temperature.
